check.description: Pointer targets are at least 24x24 CSS px (or have sufficient spacing/exception). HSBC's 44px targets exceed this.

sources.internal_policy_ref: HSBC digital accessibility framework — WCAG 2.2 AA minimum, governed by Group Digital Experience and Accessibility (mandatory on all HSBC digital projects). HSBC components use 44px targets, exceeding both the 24px AA minimum and the 44px AAA (2.5.5) target.
